# Bench

> America's largest online bookkeeping platform for small businesses, offering automated accounting, tax filing, and comprehensive financial management solutions.

Bench provides end-to-end bookkeeping and accounting services for small businesses, combining AI-powered automation with expert human accountants. The platform integrates with popular business tools like Stripe, Shopify, and PayPal to streamline financial workflows.

## Key Topics

- Online bookkeeping
- Small business accounting
- Tax filing and preparation
- Tax resolution
- Back taxes
- IRS tax relief
- Financial reporting
- Transaction categorization
- Business banking
- Catch-up bookkeeping
- Tax compliance
- Financial statements
- Automated accounting
- Tax penalties and liens
- Business integrations

## Core Bookkeeping Services

- [Online Bookkeeping Services for Small Businesses - Bench Accounting](https://www.bench.co): Bench Accounting: America's largest online bookkeeping solution for small businesses.

- [Secure Assistance and Relief for IRS Back Taxes with Bench Retro](https://www.bench.co/catch-up-bookkeeping): Bench Retro: Catch-up bookkeeping and IRS back tax resolution services.

## Tax Resolution Services

- [Tax Resolution Services by Specialists at Bench Accounting](https://www.bench.co/tax-resolution): Comprehensive tax resolution services for IRS back taxes and tax debt settlement.

- [Remove IRS and State Tax Liens with Expert Help from Bench Accounting](https://www.bench.co/tax-resolution/lien-help): IRS tax lien resolution and relief services with affordable payment plans.
